title: Arab Union for Cement and Building Materials opens Arab International Cement and Building Materials Conference and Exhibition 2026 in Cairo
summary: Arab Union for Cement and Building Materials opens Arab International Cement and Building Materials Conference and Exhibition 2026 in Cairo
body_markdown:
**Egypt:** The 29th Arab International Cement and Building Materials Conference and Exhibition is underway at the Heliopolis Congress Complex in Cairo. The Arab Union for Cement and Building Materials (AUCBM) is hosting the event from 23 – 25 November 2026. AUCBM Secretary General Ahmad Mahmoud Al-Rousan opened conference proceedings in front of 750 delegates. Council of Arab Economic Unity Secretary General Mohamdy Ahmed Neya opened the event’s exhibition area of around 150 stands.


Attendees can pick up complimentary copies of the Global Cement Magazine November 2026 issue and meet delegates Robert McCaffrey and Fatima Zunehra at the Global Cement stand, R45.


*Pictured: Eng. Ahmad Al Rousan and HE Mohamdy Ahmed Neya, Secretary General, Council of Arab Economic Unity open the exhibition at the 29th Arab International Cement and Building Materials Conference and Exhibition*
